subject: general
question:
Identify the person from the given statements.

Popularly known as the “King of Pop”, the best-selling American singer, songwriter and dancer
solution:
The correct answer is __**Michael Jackson**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Michael Jackson was born on August 29, 1958, and died on June 25, 2009.
 
• Jackson was an American singer, songwriter, dancer, and philanthropist.
 
• He is known as "The King of Pop" and is regarded as one of the most significant cultural figures of the 20th century.
 
• Some honors given to Jackson include:
 
 
• "Presidential Public Safety Commendation" award by Ronald Reagan in 1984.
 
• "Artist of the Decade" by George H. W. Bush in 1990.
 
• "Point of Light Ambassador" by Bush in 1992.
 
 
 
• The RIAA regards him as the biggest-selling music artist of all time worldwide.
 
• Jackson has 13 Grammy Awards, Grammy Legend Award, Grammy Legend Award, and many more awards.
 
• In 2021, he was among the inaugural inductees into the Black Music & Entertainment Walk of Fame.
